name: LPUniversity
english_description: A classic English-language LPC teaching/reference mudlib, positioned by its own lpmuds.net description as not ready for play -- a base for learning to build a lib without dealing much with the driver. What shipped is more complete than that framing suggests: a full login/registration/security/command-dispatch/help/mail/message-board/news/channel/Intermud-3 engine including a real first-boot admin-setup wizard, plus one small real starting domain: an entrance room with a greeter NPC leading north to a single upstairs floor holding a cafe (complete with a serving station and stained tables), a bar, a lounge, a bathroom, and a backroom, all connected to each other rather than the "three upstairs floors" a first pass at this description assumed. There is no combat/stats system at all. Also makes a real outbound Intermud-3 network connection at boot, same as imud/tmi2/skylib.
